author: meeting-bot@foo.be
title: HR & Hiring Managers Sync - Q1 2025 (AI summary)
body:
Meeting summary (auto-generated)
Attendees: Sophie Claes (HR & Immigration Lead), Pieter Janssens, Amira Haddad, Laura De Smet

Overview
The team met for the quarterly HR and hiring sync. The conversation was productive and covered a wide range of topics related to hiring, onboarding, employer branding and the upcoming recruitment season. Overall sentiment was positive, and participants expressed appreciation for the collaboration between HR and the hiring managers over the past quarter.

1. Recruitment pipeline
Amira shared that the sales team has several strong candidates in the pipeline, including one candidate from Brazil. Pieter mentioned that engineering is planning to open two additional roles later in the year. The group discussed the importance of a consistent candidate experience and agreed to revisit the interview scorecards next quarter.

2. Employer branding
Laura suggested refreshing the careers page with employee testimonials. Several participants agreed this would be valuable. No owner was assigned.

3. Non-EU hiring process (decision)
Sophie explained that the single permit application is now fully handled through the online "Working in Belgium" platform, and the regional department no longer accepts files sent by email. Only registered company users can submit, and Sophie is the registered user for Foo.
Decision: From now on, hiring managers do NOT send single permit applications themselves. Hiring managers collect the candidate's documents in the shared HR folder, and Sophie submits every application through the platform. Sophie is the owner of this process and the contact for all questions about non-EU hiring.
Sophie also noted that the salary thresholds for highly qualified workers are updated every January, so hiring managers must check the salary with her before making an offer. Recent applications have been processed in about 2.5 to 3 months.
Sophie will update the wiki page.

4. Onboarding
The group briefly discussed the onboarding buddy programme and agreed it is working well.

Action items
- Sophie: update the non-EU hiring wiki page.
- Amira: send Camila Souza's documents to Sophie.
- Laura: explore careers page refresh.
